description: "Use when working in apps/web (Vite + React). Enforce package manager, data-fetching defaults, and database safety rules."
applyTo: "apps/web/**"

# Web Project Instructions

- Use `yarn` for all package manager operations.
- Always use TanStack Query for data fetching in React code.
- When creating a new service, use if already exists or create the types/interfaces in the shared package.
